quote: "Preference Amount" means an amount equal to the greater of (i) 1.4x of the Purchase Amount and (ii) an amount equal to the Purchase Amount plus 20% interest per annum, compounding annually, from the date of this Agreement; provided, however, that in no event shall the Preference Amount exceed 1.7x of the Purchase Amount.
